hypothesis: The full-history v295 expert may lose stable identity information by representing racers, branches, motors, boats, venues, and race numbers only through aggregate numeric summaries. Adding these IDs as native categorical variables to the same exact-top3 stages can recover nonlinear identity interactions without ordinal ID arithmetic.

features.numeric_base: v295 raw 24, official-course runner 5, pairwise-history 8, current-meet 8, race 12, official-course race 4; unchanged
features.stage1_categories: candidate runner four IDs plus venue and race number
features.stage2_categories: candidate and selected-first runner IDs plus venue and race number
features.stage3_categories: candidate, selected-first, and selected-second runner IDs plus venue and race number
features.categorical_arithmetic: forbidden; no subtraction, averaging, ordering, or numeric scaling of category IDs
features.unknown_category: existing encoded zero or LightGBM unseen category handling; no target-based imputation
features.missing: numeric LightGBM native; official-course missing 865 races remains zero with availability zero

training.fold_rows: all strictly-prior raw races for each fold
training.screen_rows: fixed acceleration cache indices after complete-series history construction
stages: second among five conditioned on first
third among four conditioned on first and second
training.history_features: v295 pairwise tau20 and seven-day current-meet definitions unchanged

model.library: LightGBM grouped conditional softmax with native categorical features

anchoring.optimizer: deterministic bounded scalar exact-top3 logloss minimization

promotion_requires: v295 delta below zero, race-date bootstrap CI95 upper below zero, and v295 child-family Holm p below 0.05
